text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"NASA-047","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N2","page":1,"quote":"MTC REPORT REQURIED NON DESTRUCTIVE TESTING RAW MATERIAL HEAT TREATMENT FINISH COMPOMENT UT DP+UT MPI"}],"comment":"Note N2 requires penetrant (DP) and ultrasonic (UT) inspection on the finish component but does not state that this NDT must be performed before the IZBP surface treatment specified in note N6. Without a separate note sequencing the inspection before finishing, the plating may mask surface defects or be damaged by the test. Add a note explicitly requiring DP and UT to be completed before the IZBP surface treatment is applied.","recommended_correction":"Add a note stating that all required NDT (DP, UT, MPI) shall be performed prior to the IZBP surface treatment."},{"rule_id":"WF-014","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N1","page":1,"quote":"T + S NOTE : H.T.PROCESS : HARDENED HARDNESS & DEPTH : UPTO 32-35 HRC.THROUGH FINISH & DEPTH : IZBP TEST COUPON SIZE : ⌀40 (20mmLENGTH - 01NOS) WELD CLASS : B IF APPLICABLE"}],"comment":"Note N1 references 'WELD CLASS : B IF APPLICABLE' for this shaft, which implies structural welds may be present, yet no NDT requirements are stated for those welds. Missing weld NDT criteria means there is no defined acceptance standard for any welds made during fabrication or repair. The designer should specify the applicable NDT methods and acceptance criteria for any welds produced under Weld Class B.","recommended_correction":"Specify the required NDT methods and acceptance criteria for welds when Weld Class B is invoked."}]}
